keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Nesto Groen (Excelsior) is shown the red card.
Delay in match because of an injury Robin Pröpper (Twente).
Delay in match because of an injury Nesto Groen (Excelsior).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Excelsior 0, Twente 1. Wout Weghorst (Twente) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Sondre Ørjasæter with a cross.
Wout Weghorst (Twente) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Excelsior 0, Twente 2. Wout Weghorst (Twente) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Sondre Ørjasæter.
Goal! Excelsior 0, Twente 3. Wout Weghorst (Twente) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Sondre Ørjasæter.
Goal! Excelsior 0, Twente 4. Thomas van den Belt (Twente) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the centre of the goal.
Lennard Hartjes (Excelsior) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Excelsior 0, Twente 5. Daan Rots (Twente) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Sondre Ørjasæter.
First Half ends, Excelsior 0, Twente 5.
Substitution, Excelsior. Mario Domínguez replaces Aymen Sliti.
Substitution, Twente. Michal Rosiak replaces Bart van Rooij.
Substitution, Excelsior. Eric da Silva Moreira replaces Daniël van Vianen.
Substitution, Twente. Jordy Bawuah replaces Ruud Nijstad.
Goal! Excelsior 0, Twente 6. Jordy Bawuah (Twente) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Sondre Ørjasæter.
Goal! Excelsior 0, Twente 7. Wout Weghorst (Twente) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Twente. Marko Pjaca replaces Sondre Ørjasæter.
Substitution, Excelsior. Simon Janssen replaces Irakli Yegoian.
Substitution, Twente. Lucas Vennegoor of Hesselink replaces Wout Weghorst.
Delay in match because of an injury Stijn van Gassel (Excelsior).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Excelsior 0, Twente 8. Ramiz Zerrouki (Twente) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Twente. Kristian Hlynsson replaces Robin Pröpper.
Goal! Excelsior 0, Twente 9. Daan Rots (Twente) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Thomas van den Belt with a through ball.
Substitution, Excelsior. Valentin Sulzbacher replaces Noah Naujoks.
Second Half ends, Excelsior 0, Twente 9.
